title: Localqw6 kusuma gui MAV GUI V1
script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Sürüklenebilir Frame
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.4, 0) 
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0.3, 0) 
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50) 
frame.BorderSizePixel = 2
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true
frame.Parent = screenGui

-- **Kuş sesi ekle**
local birdSound = Instance.new("Sound", game.Workspace)
birdSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://7154698362" -- Kuş sesi
birdSound.Looped = true
birdSound.Volume = 1
birdSound:Play()

-- **Buton oluşturma fonksiyonu**
local function createButton(name, position, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.08, 0)
    button.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, position, 0)
    button.Text = name
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    button.Parent = frame
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    return button
end

-- **Skybox 1**
createButton("Skybox", 0.1, function()
    game.Lighting.Sky.SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://78288115972285"
    game.Lighting.Sky.SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://78288115972285"
    game.Lighting.Sky.SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://78288115972285"
    game.Lighting.Sky.SkyboxRt = "rbxassetid://78288115972285"
    game.Lighting.Sky.SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://78288115972285"
    game.Lighting.Sky.SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://78288115972285"
end)

-- **Skybox 2**
createButton("Skybox 2", 0.2, function()
    game.Lighting.Sky.SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://121828852378807"
    game.Lighting.Sky.SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://121828852378807"
    game.Lighting.Sky.SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://121828852378807"
    game.Lighting.Sky.SkyboxRt = "rbxassetid://121828852378807"
    game.Lighting.Sky.SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://121828852378807"
    game.Lighting.Sky.SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://121828852378807"
end)

-- **Music (Kuş Sesi)**
createButton("Music", 0.3, function()
    birdSound:Play()
end)

-- **Hint Mesajı**
createButton("Hint", 0.4, function()
    local hint = Instance.new("Hint", game.Workspace)
    hint.Text = "🐦🐦🐦🐦🐦🐦"
    wait(3)
    hint:Destroy()
end)

-- **Sabit Sil**
createButton("Sabit Sil", 0.5, function()
    for _, v in pairs(game.Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") then
            v.Anchored = false
        end
    end
end)

-- **Blok Nuke**
createButton("Blok Nuke", 0.6, function()
    while true do
        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Size = Vector3.new(1,1,1)
        part.Position = Vector3.new(math.random(-100,100),50,math.random(-100,100))
        part.Parent = game.Workspace
        wait(0.05)
    end
end)

-- **Fire All (Yanma)**
createButton("Fire All", 0.7, function()
    for _, v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if v.Character then
            local fire = Instance.new("Fire", v.Character:FindFirstChild("Head"))
            fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
            fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)
        end
    end
end)

-- **Ultra Işık**
createButton("Ultra Işık", 0.8, function()
    for _, v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if v.Character then
            for _, obj in pairs(v.Character:GetChildren()) do
                if obj:IsA("Shirt") or obj:IsA("Pants") then
                    obj:Destroy()
                end
            end
            local light = Instance.new("PointLight", v.Character:FindFirstChild("Head"))
            light.Brightness = 100
            light.Range = 50
        end
    end
end)

-- **Nuker**
createButton("Nuker", 0.9, function()
    for _, v in pairs(game.Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") then
            v.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            v.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
            v.Anchored = false
            v.Velocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-50,50),math.random(-50,50),math.random(-50,50))
        end
    end
    
    for _, v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if v.Character then
            v.Character.Head.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) -- Yeşil karakter
            local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion", game.Workspace)
            explosion.Position = v.Character.Head.Position
        end
    end

    -- Müzik Çalma
    local music = Instance.new("Sound", game.Workspace)
    music.SoundId = "rbxassetid://16190760285"
    music.Volume = 88888
    music.Pitch = 0.50
    music:Play()

    -- Sohbet mesajı
    for i = 10, 1, -1 do
        game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("ChatMakeSystemMessage", {
            Text = "I gave you seconds: " .. i,
            Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
            Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
        })
        wait(1)
    end

    -- Oyun tamamen bozuluyor
    for _, v in pairs(game.Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") then
            v.Color = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(0,255), math.random(0,255), math.random(0,255))
        end
    end

    for _, v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if v.Character then
            v.Character.Head.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        end
    end
end)
